grammar_focus: no sooner ... than(一…就…,句首倒装)、as ... as / not as ... as 比较、made in / made by / made of / made from 辨析、it takes sb + 时间 + to do、while / as + 过去进行(被 when 打断)、so far / to this day + 现在完成(原创承载 NCE3 L28 考点·无需净化·美国游客在异国港口跟小贩砍价,五美元'淘'到一支永远写不出字的钢笔)
scene: 大邮轮刚驶进港口,一艘艘装满货物的小船就飞快靠了过来。船还没抛锚,小贩们已经爬上了甲板,一转眼,甲板上就铺满了色彩斑斓的地毯、丝绸、铜咖啡壶,还有漂亮的手工银器。让人很难不动心。船上不少乘客已经开始和商贩讨价还价,可我打定主意,上岸之前什么都不买。我刚下船,一个男人就冲上来,急着要卖我一枚钻戒。我压根没想买,却又掩饰不住:那些钻石之大,让我吃了一惊——有几颗足有玻璃球那么大。为了证明是真货,他把一颗钻石往店铺橱窗上一按,竟在玻璃上划出一道深痕。我费了半个多小时才把他打发走。下一个凑上来的男人卖的是高档钢笔和手表。我仔细看了看其中一支笔,确实像真的,金笔帽底部还工整地刻着“美国制造”几个字。那人赌咒说这笔值五十美元,不过作为特别优惠,三十美元就卖给我。我摇摇头,竖起五根手指,表示只出五美元。他两臂乱挥,一副我的报价荒唐透顶的样子,可很快就把价钱降到了十美元。我耸耸肩转身要走——没走几步,他追上来,把笔硬塞进我手里,痛痛快快收下了那五美元。我为自己这桩绝妙的便宜货得意极了——直到回到船上。任我怎么使劲,就是没法给这支漂亮的笔灌上墨水;直到今天,它一个字也没写出来过!

grammar_card.title: no sooner...than / as...as / made in·by·of / it takes sb to do
grammar_card.intro: ①no sooner … than “一…就…”;no sooner 放句首要倒装:No sooner had I sat down than…。②as + 形容词 + as “与…一样…”;not as … as “不像…那么…”。③made in(产地)/ made by(制作者)/ made of(看得出原料)/ made from(看不出原料)。④it takes sb + 时间 + to do “某人花多少时间做某事”。⑤while / as + 过去进行,常被 when 引导的“突然发生”打断。⑥so far / to this day + 现在完成时,表示“到目前为止”。

rows: No sooner had I got off than…
it takes sb 时间 to do / so far
花时间做… / 到目前为止
It took me half an hour…

specialRules.rule: no sooner … than 的搭配是 than(不是 then / when);no sooner 放句首时,主句要倒装:No sooner had he… than…。
made of 看得出原料(a table made of wood);made from 看不出原料(paper made from wood);made in 是产地;made by 是制作者。
美式用词:store(英式 shop)、dollar(货币,英式常用 pound)、sidewalk(英式 pavement)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why was even five dollars 'too dear' for the pen?
options: The pen could never be made to write

passage: Small boats loaded with wares sped out to the great cruise ship as she was entering the harbor. Before she had even anchored, the sellers had climbed aboard, and the decks were soon covered with colorful rugs, silks, copper coffee pots, and beautiful handmade silverware. It was hard not to be tempted. Many passengers had already begun bargaining with the traders, but I decided to buy nothing until I had gone ashore. I had no sooner stepped off the ship than a man rushed up, eager to sell me a diamond ring. I had no intention of buying one, yet I could not hide the fact that I was impressed by the size of the diamonds; some were as big as marbles. To prove they were real, the man pressed one against a store window and cut a deep line in the glass. It took me over half an hour to get rid of him. The next man was selling fancy pens and watches. I examined one of the pens closely; it certainly looked genuine, and near the base of the gold cap the words 'Made in the U.S.A.' had been neatly inscribed. The man swore the pen was worth fifty dollars, but as a special favor he would let me have it for thirty. I shook my head and held up five fingers, offering five. Waving his arms wildly, he acted as if my offer were outrageous, yet he soon dropped the price to ten. Shrugging, I began to walk away, and a moment later he ran after me and thrust the pen into my hands, gladly taking my five dollars. I felt very pleased with my wonderful bargain, until I got back to the ship. No matter how hard I tried, it was impossible to fill that beautiful pen with ink, and to this day it has never written a single word!

stage5.stem_cn: 他刚讲完,大家就鼓起掌来。

stage5.stem: "My offer was ___ low as five dollars."(“…到…程度”的比较结构)

stage5.stem_cn: 我花了半个多小时才摆脱他。

stage5.stem: "It ___ about ten minutes to walk to the harbor."(it ___ 时间 to do,一般现在)

stage5.stem: "It has ___ me years to learn to bargain well."(it has ___ 时间,现在完成)

stage5.stem: "___ we were walking past a shop, he cut the glass."(引导“当…正在…时”的连词)

stage5.stem: "I was just going into the shop ___ he grabbed my arm."(过去进行被“突然发生”打断,用哪个)

stage5.stem: "The pen has never written a word ___."(表“到目前为止”,配合现在完成)

stage5.stem: "To argue over the price to make it lower is to ___."(“讨价还价”用哪个词)
